scenarios.starting_prompt: Give me an inventory of user tables in the ${SPANNER_DATABASE} Spanner PostgreSQL database, including columns and constraints.
scenarios.conversation_plan: The user wants a table schema inventory. Accept a short summary and end the conversation.

scenarios.starting_prompt: What PostgreSQL tables exist in ${SPANNER_DATABASE}? After checking the tables, run a read-only query using the PostgreSQL dialect to verify the current schema version or table contents.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Turn 1: agent lists tables. Turn 2: agent runs read-only SQL. Accept the output and end the conversation.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Search our data catalog for assets related to database or table metadata in this project.
scenarios.conversation_plan: The user wants to find data assets using catalog search. Accept the catalog search results and end the conversation.
